# Ilse

> The designer's eye inside the code agent. Point at what's wrong in the running app in the browser; your own coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor CLI, Gemini CLI) fixes it in the code — or Ilse applies it itself when no AI is needed. Local only, no API keys of its own. MIT.

## Use it

- Install and run, in a React project's folder: `npx ilse-design` (starts the dev server behind Ilse and opens the app at its usual address with the toolbar)
- [README](README.md): what it does, requirements, how to run it (Portuguese: README.pt-BR.md)
- [How it works](docs/how-it-works.md): locating code, the cost ladder, models, safety checks, undo, usage limits, commits
- [Reference](docs/reference.md): install, modes, toolbar, CLI, environment switches, logs, MCP, Claude accounts, compatibility

## Work on it

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): commands, rules, code map, recipes, definition of done — start here
